goalMode.scope: All eligible image containers on the current canvas by default, or an exact explicit GUI/CLI boundary, frozen as one ordered TaskScope with one binding per image slot.
goalMode.explicitBoundaryPolicy: An explicit node boundary is atomic and never silently widened or reduced.

batchSafety.probe: Serially validate one representative image from each of 1-2 distinct containers.
batchSafety.stopPolicy: Stop immediately on any probe failure; open the circuit on later protected or concentrated failures.
batchSafety.feeBoundary: Only undispatched work can be prevented; requests already accepted upstream may still complete and incur charges.

v1.ordinaryItemsPolicy: For operationsPerAsset > 1, omit items to repeat one prompt or provide items exactly equal to operationsPerAsset for per-output prompts.

commerceItemsPolicy.multipleOutputs: items is required and must exactly equal operationsPerAsset; slotId, slotIndex, and localeCode live only on each item and must match trusted plan order.
commerceItemsPolicy.singleOutput: items is forbidden; slotId, slotIndex, and localeCode are required at the top level and must match the trusted plan.
commerceItemsPolicy.ordinaryGoal: A Goal without frozen commercePlanHash forbids commerce markers, hashes, slot metadata, and locale metadata.

commerceSet.sourcePolicy: One or more exact mother-image nodes or containers are frozen atomically; every eligible image binding remains independently traceable.

plan.listingSetSlots: 1-12 slots with an independent title and prompt per slot
plan.targetLanguages: 0-10 for generation and 1-10 for translation, with an independent prompt per locale

executionContract: the trusted normalized plan and exact source boundary produce one deterministic commercePlanHash
preview and confirmation use the same one-time agent.goal ledger; any source, slot, prompt, locale, or save-target change requires a new preview
for multiple outputs, items length equals operationsPerAsset and each item metadata exactly matches trusted slot and locale order
for one output, items is omitted and slotId, slotIndex, and localeCode are top-level metadata
ordinary Goals reject all commerce markers, hashes, slot metadata, and locale metadata
all matrix shape, count, order, and hash failures reject before provider dispatch

reusableNode.inputRelations: Preserve every selected mother-image input relation.
reusableNode.creationFence: Create only after confirmed Goal dispatch is accepted; cancellation, expiry, stale hash, or rejection creates nothing.

invariants: renderer registry, CLI reference, and tests are generated from one shared schema
canvas.state returns the authoritative canvas revision, locks, relations, and active state
canvas.select validates every id and primary id before changing selection
every graph mutation requires the expected project id and may use expected canvas revision for compare-and-set
requirement update and execute additionally require the requirement revision
every explicit node and edge validates before one atomic commit
cycle, lock, stale, and unsupported-member failures never shrink to a valid subset
requirement execute fences revision and TaskScope before asynchronous Agent dispatch; provider and result persistence are not part of the graph commit
same-project-and-conversation owners do not share pause or stop state
overlapping nodes remain mutually exclusive across owners
renderer destruction stops every run owned by that renderer
renderer destruction immediately rejects its pending automation commands
the final run releases its idle scope state
application shutdown stops all runs before transports are dismantled
accepted provider requests continue draining under Main-process admission
top-level node fields merge by their mutation clocks while the same field resolves by Main commit order
only a writer that actually saves refreshes its checkpoint
writers inactive for 30 days may leave the tombstone GC quorum
delete and restore history may compact into a causal barrier without allowing stale resurrection
explicit undo may restore a tombstone observed by that writer
assets, generation terminal/progress state, and provenance retain specialized compatibility policies
this is not a recursive-field or remote multi-user CRDT

remoteAssetSecurity.policy: Recorded project remote images may use public HTTP(S) only. Every redirect hop is resolved and pinned before a fresh connection; the actual socket address must match the approved public set.
remoteAssetSecurity.rendererBoundary: New provider URL results are materialized into managed files before entering the canvas. Legacy recorded URLs render only through naimage-asset; direct Renderer HTTP(S) image loading is blocked by CSP.

invariants: unknown generated formats are rejected before provider dispatch, and encoded bytes must match the requested generated format
GUI and canvas.export-image use one shared format registry and native Save authorization
JPEG flattens transparency over white
local conversion does not call an image model or mutate the managed source

bundlePolicy.maintenancePolicy: Prefer natural async boundaries, but never sacrifice maintainability or add risky refactors or complex splitting merely to cross any Bundle hard gate or advisory number.

invariants: exact manifest bytes are bound by a separate integrity sidecar
goal, catalog, package scripts, runner, SUPER GOAL contract validator, and workpack protocol hashes fail closed on drift
a full super-goal profile workpack includes every declared workstream owner lane
independent runner processes use collision-resistant exclusively created run directories
one atomic claim can launch each agent lane
all prior wave agents must pass before a later wave starts
declared resources are mutually exclusive across workpack processes
checkpoints are immutable and hash chained
stale reclaim requires an explicit command and refuses a live parent or child pid
runner result and report paths are deterministic and hash bound
GUI closure requires real Electron screenshots, montage coverage, reviewer, and verdict
every collect writes an immutable closure snapshot
a closure proves only the exact input hashes frozen in its manifest; any goal, catalog, package, runner, or protocol drift requires a new workpack

historicalClosure.scope: Verified only for the frozen 2026-07-29 inputs; it does not cover the later commerce matrix and fee admission, session v5 journal and dual-Renderer conflicts, or explicit TaskScope steer.

requiredInputMatch: AIDEBUG runner and workpack protocol inputs
closure.requiredOutcome: A newly emitted and collected full workpack must pass every owner lane, verification task, and required visual review with inputDrift = 0.

completionRule: Every changed workstream has direct passing evidence and reviewed visual evidence when user-visible, and the current full workpack closure must match every current input hash with inputDrift = 0.
